proof_body:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (0 : ℝ)
  · simpa using hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (0 : ℝ)
  · intro h
    have hc : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (t, t)) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) := by
      have : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => (t, t)) 0 := by fun_prop
      exact this.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have h3 := h.tendsto.comp hc
    have hev : (fun t : ℝ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ] ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * p.2 / (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) ∘ fun t : ℝ => (t, t)) := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
      have ht' : t ≠ 0 := ht
      simp only [Function.comp]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h4 := tendsto_nhds_unique (h3.congr' hev.symm) tendsto_const_nhds
    norm_num at h4
target_source: HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * p.2 / (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) (x, 0)) 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * p.2 / (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) (0, y)) 0 0 ∧ ¬ ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * p.2 / (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) (0, 0)
